Module 10: Editorial Consolidation & CI/CD — Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, students will be able to:

  • Orchestrate distributed Git collaboration workflows, including repository forking, branch management, pull requests, and upstream synchronization.
  • Adjudicate and resolve merge conflicts inside complex TEI XML documents without introducing malformed markup or corrupting witness readings.
  • Execute comprehensive validation sweeps across multi-file edition corpora using xmllint, Relax NG, and Schematron.
  • Implement continuous integration (CI) pipelines using GitHub Actions to automate schema validation gates upon push.
  • Conduct scholarly peer code reviews, opening clear, actionable issue tickets and verifying reproducibility across editorial milestones.
